greeting: Good morning, Haniel! AZ Team AI’s billing system is ready for its production debut — the DO droplet is waiting. Today you ship it.
hype: You’re one deploy away from live SaaS billing infrastructure. After that, Label lane v2 kills the demo-blocker on Takeoff Engine. Two high-leverage ships in one day — let’s go.

schedule.title: DO droplet deploy — bare-metal LEMP on azteam-vps
schedule.prep: Open DigitalOcean dashboard → SSH into azteam-vps. Install LEMP stack (nginx, MySQL, PHP). Clone repo, run composer install, configure .env.production, run migrations. Nginx vhost → https://fin.azteam.cloud. Exit criteria: app loads over HTTPS with no errors.

schedule.title: Secrets in .env.production
schedule.prep: Cross-reference .env.example against .env.production. Fill in: DB_*, STRIPE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET, MAIL_*, APP_KEY. Set file permissions to 600. Verify .gitignore covers .env* before any commit.

schedule.title: Reconciliation gate
schedule.prep: Open the reconciliation scheduled job. It must compare Stripe subscription states against DB invoice records and flag mismatches. Seed one invoice pair (paid in Stripe, pending in DB) and confirm the job catches it. Exit criteria: mismatch report logged and admin alerted.

schedule.title: Label lane v2 — outlined-text detection for unnamed rooms
schedule.prep: Open the label lane module in Takeoff Engine. Bug: rooms show ‘unnamed’ because PDFTron returns empty text for outline-only glyphs. Patch extraction logic to detect outlined paths via bounding-box heuristic or glyph-path fallback. Exit criteria: demo PDF shows named rooms in the lane panel.

schedule.title: Assemblies-per-room quantities (paint / drywall / flooring)
schedule.prep: Open the assembly calculation module. Implement per-room area breakdowns: paint (net wall area minus openings), drywall (gross wall + ceiling), flooring (floor area). Output must drive the estimator-grade Excel export. This closes Phase 6’s last open pillar — completing it unblocks the full Excel deliverable.
